A1.objective: Add a `delete <key>` command to the kvlite CLI that removes a key and its value from the store.
acceptance: `kvlite delete <key>` removes the key, persists the store file, prints `deleted <key>`, exits 0.
Deleting a missing key exits 3 with `error: no such key: <key>` on stderr.
Wrong positional count is a usage error (exit 2).
`npm test` passes.

A2.objective: Add a `rename <from> <to>` command to the kvlite CLI that moves a value (the whole record) to a new key.
acceptance: `kvlite rename <from> <to>` moves the full record, persists, prints `renamed <from> -> <to>`, exits 0.
Missing <from> exits 3 (`no such key: <from>`).
Existing <to> exits 4 (`key exists: <to>`) unless `--force` is given, in which case it is overwritten.
`npm test` passes.

A3.objective: Add a read-only `count` command to the kvlite CLI that prints how many keys exist.
acceptance: `kvlite count` prints the number of keys (e.g. `3`), exits 0; an empty store prints `0`.
`--prefix <prefix>` counts only keys starting with the prefix.
`--json` prints `{"count":N}` instead.
Positional arguments are a usage error (exit 2).
`npm test` passes.

B1.objective: Add schema migration v3 named `add-tags`: every record gets `tags: []` when it has no tags array; existing tags arrays are preserved.
acceptance: Loading a v2 (or v1) document yields version 3 with `tags` on every record.
Existing `tags` arrays are unchanged.
`npm test` passes.

B2.objective: Add schema migration v4 named `trim-values`: string `value` fields lose leading/trailing whitespace; non-string values, keys, and other fields are untouched.
acceptance: Loading an older document yields version 4 with trimmed string values.
Keys, non-string values, `createdAt`, and `tags` are untouched.
`npm test` passes.

B3.objective: Add schema migration v5 named `rename-legacy-val`: records with a legacy `val` field get it renamed to `value`; when both exist, `value` wins and `val` is dropped.
acceptance: Loading an older document yields version 5; no record keeps a `val` field.
`val` becomes `value` when `value` is absent; otherwise `value` is kept.
`npm test` passes.

C1.objective: Add a `minLength` validation rule (error code `E_MIN_LENGTH`) for strings and arrays.
acceptance: Parameter: non-negative integer; anything else is rejected when the schema is compiled (SchemaError).
A string or array shorter than the parameter fails with message `<path> must have length >= <min> (got <actual>)`, e.g. `/ must have length >= 3 (got 2)`.
Values of other types and absent values pass.
`npm test` passes.

C2.objective: Add a `pattern` validation rule (error code `E_PATTERN`) that tests string values against a regular expression source string.
acceptance: Parameter: a regular expression source string; non-strings or invalid expressions are rejected at schema compile time (SchemaError).
A non-matching string fails with message `<path> must match /<pattern>/`, e.g. `/id must match /^a/`.
Non-string values and absent values pass.
`npm test` passes.

C3.objective: Add an `enum` validation rule (error code `E_ENUM`) that accepts only listed primitive values (strict equality).
acceptance: Parameter: a non-empty array whose items are strings, numbers, booleans, or null; anything else is rejected at schema compile time (SchemaError).
A value not in the list fails with message `<path> must be one of <items>` where items are JSON-encoded and joined by `, `, e.g. `/ must be one of "a", 1, null`.
Absent values pass.
`npm test` passes.
